title: factdiff.py anchor --file leaves a still-failing unlocated row unchanged instead of rewriting it on every run
goal: Since ST-t3mrfi57 anchor --file refetches every fact whose only anchor row is unlocated:fetch-error, not-text or gone, and a retry that fails again rewrites the row with a new verified_utc, so _anchors.csv changes on every run for a still-failing source and gone rows are refetched with no backoff. A retry whose status is unchanged keeps the row as it was, and a gone row is retried only after a backoff the docs state. Found by the SP-srqmriw6 review of ST-t3mrfi57 (its gate g2 chose replace the row).
